chapter: Blanton, Los Angeles and Art Tatum
title: Who sat in with the Tatum trio
summary: Almost nobody sat in; occasionally horn players such as Don Byas and Roy Eldridge did, but not Charlie Parker.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Did many people sit in with you all when you played?
Do you remember any who did?
I think once we were playing a gig, a guitarist sat in Tiny's place, but no one has never sat in in my place with Tatum.
Oh, yes, once in a while a horn player would join us, you know, trumpet sometimes, saxophone.
Do you remember who any of the guys were that sat in with the band, any horn players?
-- at one time Don, Don Byas.
Yeah, he was able to handle it.
Did Charlie Parker ever sit in with you all?
